evidence_items.explanation: Ramp’s transaction sample documents substantial paid demand, a material challenge to any literal no-demand reading. The same report discusses slowing adoption and spending pressure; it does not measure whether industry receipts cover the buildout.

evidence_items.locator: Paragraph reporting OpenAI’s 2025 revenue and cash burn
evidence_items.explanation: CNBC reports $13.1 billion of realized 2025 revenue alongside $8 billion of cash burn, citing unnamed sources. This shows commercial receipts and continuing funding needs at one company, rather than settling the entire sector’s eventual economics.

unresolved_gaps: No matched sector-wide record establishes sustained customer receipts sufficient to support the relevant buildout.
The speaker supplies no quantitative definition of sufficient demand.
One company’s cash burn cannot establish permanent industry-wide failure.
Paid adoption cannot by itself establish investment returns or capital recovery.
